workLog.task: Align five prose copies of the allowlist to the module
workLog.outcome: SESSION-PROTOCOL.md (three sites), CONTRIBUTING.md, session-init/references/template-extraction.md, session/SKILL.md (three JSON examples), and tests/evals/skills/triage-prompts.json all taught 5 patterns while scripts/modules/investigation_allowlist.py returns 8. The triage-prompts entry is a grading key, so a correct 8-path answer was being scored wrong.

The skill claimed 9 patterns (module returns 8), named a .agents/memory/episodes/ pattern that does not exist in the module (grep -c episodes: 0, control grep -c critique: 2), and cited ADR-034 lines 79-83 to prove the code had drifted wider than the ADR. Lines 84-86 continue the list with the other 3 patterns, each tagged Amendment 2026-07-08, and the amendment header sits at line 200. The citation window stopped one line short of the text that refutes it. Replaced with an executable count command.

workLog.task: Harden the parity test against widening
workLog.outcome: A mutation matrix against the real document showed containment accepted a widened allowlist: adding src/ to the protocol clause passed every test. Fixed by scoping exact set equality to the enumeration span and parsing it without a prefix filter, so a forbidden path breaks equality while contrast prose outside the span stays legal. Suite grew 19 to 35 tests. Post-fix matrix: 4 widening and narrowing mutations fail, 4 formatting mutations pass.
